Excellent! Black wins the knight cleanly. This is a classic **fork** — the knight on d3 gives check while attacking the queen and bishop, forcing White's king to move, then Black captures the undefended knight with a 3-point material gain.

---

**Best move:** Nd3+

**Main line:** Nd3+ Kb1 Qxd5 (winning the knight)

**Motif:** fork

**Coaching note:**

When you give check, look for a fork pattern. Here, Nd3+ checks the king while your knight also attacks the undefended knight on d5. After the king moves, you capture for free. Watch for moves that force your opponent to respond to check while you hit a loose piece—this pattern wins material in many positions.
